resources.string: Every rider leaves a glowing wall. Touch any wall, or the edge of the arena, and you are out; the last rider left wins the round. Your Left and Right pads turn your rider the way the rider is facing, not the way you are. Everybody plays at the same time on their own side of the screen.
%1$s: turn button. The next turn is left.
%1$s: turn button. The next turn is right.
%1$s ended a gap inside a wall.
Your gap ended inside a wall.
Time is up: nobody wins this round.
%1$s was steered away from a wall.
You were steered away from a wall.
Your Left and Right pads turn the way the rider is facing, not the way you are. Watch the glowing head.
Leave yourself room: a wall you can see is a wall you can turn away from. Trap rivals by cutting across in front of them.
Hard to play fast? Turn on Relaxed or One button in the setup.
